initial_application: There is no separate FHIR-48097-tagged source commit. additional_context: ImagingSelection is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The combined branch already contains the Preferred binding. reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative StructureDefinition already binds ImagingSelection.category with Preferred strength to the DICOM Key Object Selection Document Title value set, so the seed request is fully satisfied.
